searchText: Does MEV Boost support connecting to multiple relays? Yeah it does. It's a proxy And I'm assuming it will pick the most profitable block from all of the connected relays? Yes, but you trust the relays to give you the correct values Does MEV Boost disconnect the relay or shutdown or at least warn the operator in some way if the it is discovered that the relay lied after the fact? No way to automatically detect the value of a block (yet), so no Hmm, why not? Balance change of proposer before/after the block should be sufficient. Either you got paid the amount claimed or you didn't. This discussion has been had before, see ethresear.ch Hmm, I don't remember seeing this on ethresear.ch. Do you happen to have a link to the topic you are referring to? It is possible I missed it. https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/874767108809031740/1015194599851053098 Not ethresear.ch apparently 😅 Ah, I remember seeing this. Thanks! In the current setup, mev-boost has no access to the EL or BN at all, it's basically just a 'dumb' one-way relay multiplexer. It could however validate certain kinds of attached proofs. When MEV Boost sends a payload to the BN, does it not include the "block score"?
